transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the library management system. TRU-01 ensures only authenticated members can access borrowing features, which is critical to protect member data. TRU-02 and TRU-03 promote auditability and data protection by logging transactions and enforcing encryption. TRU-04 establishes role-based access control, which is essential for managing permissions securely. TRU-05 and TRU-06 address the secure handling of overdue notifications and personal information updates. TRU-07 enforces strong password policies to enhance account security.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent underscores the importance of ethical practices and compliance with regulations in the library management system. RES-01 ensures data protection through encryption, crucial for safeguarding member information. RES-02 promotes accessibility, ensuring fairness for all users. RES-03 emphasizes accountability by logging user actions related to borrowing and returning. RES-04 aligns with SAF-01, enforcing borrowing limits for responsible usage. RES-05 parallels EFF-05 by notifying members about overdue books, emphasizing personal responsibility. RES-06 fosters social responsibility by enabling feedback from members, and RES-07 ensures transparency through annual usage reports, building trust with the community.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the need for sustainability in the library management system. GRN-01 ensures energy-efficient operations, reducing environmental impact. GRN-04 allows members to understand the carbon footprint of their book choices, fostering eco-conscious decisions. GRN-05 ensures responsible disposal of damaged books, promoting recycling. GRN-06 tracks energy savings, quantifying the impact of digital initiatives. GRN-07 prioritizes e-books to reduce physical resources, aligning with sustainability goals.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the need for safety and reliability in the library management system. SAF-01 ensures that no member borrows more than 5 books simultaneously, preventing overextension and potential abuse. SAF-02 and SAF-05 focus on timely notifications about overdue books, promoting accountability. SAF-03 guarantees real-time inventory status to avoid double borrowing, while SAF-04 provides a backup mechanism for transaction recovery, ensuring data integrity. SAF-06's user authentication prevents unauthorized access, and SAF-07's logging of transactions ensures accountability and traceability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books.
The system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability and accountability purposes.
The system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via digital notifications.
The system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
The system shall require strong password policies for member accounts.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall adhere to library borrowing policies by enforcing a maximum of 5 books per member.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall implement a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall enable digital notifications for overdue books to reduce paper waste.
The system shall evaluate the lifecycle impact of physical books to align with sustainability goals.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books.
The system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
